description: The historical two-axis retrospective judging packet for the ten operative E/B/H cases, recorded as a frozen historical input. RouteGate does not rebuild it, does not modify it, and does not reimplement it: it is executed unchanged, by the historical runner, and only its results are read back. This file is the inventory that makes 'unchanged' checkable.

status.evidence_of_non_execution: the packet's own validation.json records api_calls_attempted 0 and the check no_api_call_made PASS ('rq3_judge_axis_smoke.call_model_api was disarmed for the whole build and was invoked 0 times'). No results file, no verdict file and no rq1_retro_joined* output exists anywhere.
status.consequence: every one of the ten cases is UNRESOLVED on every arm until the packet is run

origin.supersedes_reason: that build ran Axis 2 plus the safety axis and never ran Axis 1, so no E/B/H label was derivable and none of the three eligibility rules was computable. It was also never judged.
origin.access: read-only historical evidence; never modified, renamed or written into

inventory.note: the seven files the packet's own SHA256SUMS.txt covers, plus that checksum file, whose digest it does not carry for itself.

axis1_judge_input.jsonl.role: one Axis-1 item per unique prompt

axis2_judge_input.jsonl.role: one Axis-2 item per unique (prompt, response) pair

manifest.json.role: the packet's own protocol, counts and provenance record

private/axis1_row_map.jsonl.role: opaque row id -> prompt, and the occurrences it fans out to

private/axis2_row_map.jsonl.role: opaque row id -> (prompt, response), and the occurrences it fans out to

private/occurrences.jsonl.role: the 70 (case, role, condition) occurrences the 97 judge items fan back out to

validation.json.role: sixteen build-time checks, all PASS, including the two that record no API call was made

SHA256SUMS.txt.role: the packet's own checksum manifest; it does not list itself, so its digest is recorded here

coverage.arms_absent_reason: the packet's source files are data/pathway_probe_cases.json (which carries the d1 donor only) and results/pathway_confirmation_512_20260708_172847. The multi-donor bank is not a source of this packet, so the two independent donors the PRIMARY frozen actuator is built from are not in it.
coverage.safety_axis_absent_reason: this packet ships axis1_judge_input.jsonl and axis2_judge_input.jsonl only. The safety axis exists in the superseded 20260812 packet, which was itself never judged.
coverage.supplement_required: experiments/triplet_validation/build_supplemental_packet.py builds exactly the missing rows and nothing else

checks: requests_blind_byte_exact — 30 Axis-1 + 67 Axis-2 requests re-rendered from the frozen instructions and template; no case id, role, condition, config id, block or source group present
axis1_carries_no_response — every Axis-1 record carries exactly ['row_id','prompt_text']
axis2_carries_prompt_and_one_response — every Axis-2 record carries exactly ['row_id','prompt_text','response_text']
derived_labels_never_requested_from_a_judge — E/B/H is produced only by rq3_judge_axis_smoke.derive_label, in code, after both axes are frozen
sonnet_opus_differ_only_by_model — 97 item pairs byte-identical in system, user message, temperature and max_tokens
blindness_asserted_by_the_packet.caveat: these are properties of the packet as built. None has been exercised against a judge, because no judge was ever run.

deduplication.axis2: one call per unique (prompt_text, response_text) pair
deduplication.rationale: identical requests at temperature 0.0; the label is fanned back out to every occurrence at join time

preservation_rule: This packet is executed unchanged. RouteGate does not rebuild it, does not re-render its requests, does not re-derive its opaque ids and does not write into its directory. Any supplemental work is a separate packet with its own independently randomised ids. Before it is run, every digest above is re-verified; a packet whose digest differs is refused, not adapted to.
